response.sql: WITH frequency_averages AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS mean_signed_amount FROM frequency_averages) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(f.avg_balance) AS avg_balance, AVG(f.avg_signed_amount - m.mean_signed_amount) AS avg_excess FROM frequency_averages AS f CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE f.avg_signed_amount > m.mean_signed_amount;
